mapper.select: SELECT s.dish_id AS dishId, MAX(s.dish_name) AS dishName, MAX(d.image) AS dishImage, SUM(s.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(s.amount) AS amount FROM dish_sales s LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.id = s.dish_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE s.stall_id = #{stallId} AND s.sale_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY s.dish_id ORDER BY quantity DESC

SELECT sale_date AS saleDate, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM dish_sales WHERE stall_id = #{stallId} AND sale_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY sale_date ORDER BY sale_date ASC

SELECT sale_date AS saleDate, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM dish_sales WHERE stall_id = #{stallId} AND sale_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY sale_date ORDER BY sale_date ASC

SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, d.image AS dishImage, d.price AS price, COALESCE(rec.qty, 0) AS recentQty, COALESCE(prev.qty, 0) AS previousQty FROM dish d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT dish_id, SUM(quantity) AS qty FROM dish_sales WHERE stall_id = #{stallId} AND sale_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY dish_id ) rec ON rec.dish_id = d.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT dish_id, SUM(quantity) AS qty FROM dish_sales WHERE stall_id = #{stallId} AND sale_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND sale_date < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY dish_id ) prev ON prev.dish_id = d.id WHERE d.stall_id = #{stallId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 AND COALESCE(rec.qty, 0) > 0 ORDER BY rec.qty DESC LIMIT 10
